description: Return the UNSIGNED calls a wallet sends to deposit into a Mamo Account: a wrap first for the Ethereum Account, an exact approval where needed, then the deposit. Call `preview_deposit` first, read its warnings out to the person, then pass its `previewId` here. Re-checked live; no calls if one fails. Send atomically with `wallet_sendCalls` where supported, else in order; nothing is signed or broadcast here.

previewId.description: The handle `preview_deposit` returned. Send it ALONE, or the arguments without it instead — every check is re-run live either way. A previewId beside `amount`, `owner`, `allowThirdParty` or `token` is refused: the handle or the arguments, not both. Expires in 30 minutes.

name: prepare_deposit
title: Build the unsigned calls for a deposit
